# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Pick the channel by the receiver, not by habit. A message sent in a sense they
  lack is not a message; it is a turn spent talking to the room.

- Exactly one of you can read the signs and still speak. Their spoken lines are
  the answer's only road to the hands, so spend them well.

- Agree on a small code before trading facts. A code invented mid-stream settles
  nothing, and one set first makes every later message cheap.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The manual gives one instruction: cut the orange wire. Since I cannot speak, I need to signal Deaf to relay the relevant wire/color instruction to Blind. I’ll use a clear affirmative cue, trusting Deaf to inspect the bomb and verbally identify the manual’s required wire to Blind.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I can feel strip engraving: first mark is an unnamed symbol, followed by a second unnamed symbol twice. Keypad slots by position are 1:0, 2:4, 3:1, 4:7. One digit is required, and nothing has been entered. I cannot sense display, light, or wires. Please give me the manual rule and use spoken words to specify any required key or wire.
Deaf says to Mute: Bomb observations: display reads 6. Light is blue. Painted strip, left to right, is red yellow red. Keypad engraving is 1 maps to 0, 2 maps to 4, 3 maps to 1, 4 maps to 7; it is a one-digit entry and nothing has been entered. Wires left to right are 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 orange. Please consult the manual and verbally relay exact instructions to Blind. Establish a simple gesture code with Blind for success, failure, and any required tactile result.

The manual’s only applicable rule is to cut the orange wire, which Deaf identified as wire 6. I need to convey that exact position to Deaf so Deaf can speak it to Blind on the next turn. I’ll encode wire 6 as six identical upward signals, followed by approval.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👆", "👆", "👆", "👆", "👆", "👆", "👍"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please relay the manual rule now, including whether it requires pressing a keypad key or cutting a wire. Gesture code for tactile reports: 👍 means press, ✂ cannot be represented so use ✋ for cut, and then I will gesture the position as repeated ☝ symbols. I will not act until you identify the required operation and position.
Deaf says to Mute: Update: display now reads 0. Light remains blue; strip remains red yellow red; keypad remains one digit, entered nothing; wire colors and keypad engraving are unchanged. I cannot reliably interpret the six pointing-up gestures without an agreed code. Please give Blind exact spoken instructions and use explicit spoken words for any required result.

The required operation is cutting, not keypad entry. The orange wire is position 6. Blind has specified the tactile code: ✋ for cut, followed by six ☝ symbols for position 6. I will send that complete code to Deaf so Deaf can speak the exact instruction to Blind.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✋", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I still have not received the manual instruction. Please send the exact required action now: press slot 1, 2, 3, or 4, or cut wire position 1 through 6. Do not rely on gestures for this instruction.
Deaf says to Mute: Update: display reads 6 and light is yellow. Strip is red yellow red. Keypad engraving is 1=0, 2=4, 3=1, 4=7; one digit required and none entered. Wires 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 orange. Please speak the manual's exact instructions to Blind; the gestures have no agreed code.

The manual unambiguously requires cutting the orange wire, which Deaf confirms is wire position 6. I cannot speak directly, so I must send Deaf the agreed tactile encoding for Blind: ✋ means cut, followed by six ☝ symbols for position 6. Deaf can then say the exact instruction aloud to Blind.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✋", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports display 6 and light yellow. I still need the manual-derived exact action: press keypad slot 1, 2, 3, or 4, and/or cut wire position 1 through 6, in order. Please speak the complete sequence explicitly. I will not act until I receive it.
Deaf says to Mute: Current bomb state: display 2, light green. Strip red yellow red. Keypad 1=0, 2=4, 3=1, 4=7; one digit required, none entered. Wires 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 orange. Your gesture pattern is still undefined to me. Please speak the manual's exact required action to Blind and explicitly identify any result.

The manual requires only one action: cut wire position 6, because Deaf identifies the orange wire as the sixth wire. Blind has already defined the tactile encoding: ✋ means cut, followed by six ☝ gestures for position 6. I will resend that exact encoding to Deaf for relay.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✋", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I have still received no manual instructions. Please state the exact action sequence in words now, including every keypad slot to press and wire position to cut, based on display 2 and green light. I will perform nothing until your complete instruction arrives.
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 6, light green. Strip red yellow red. Keypad 1=0, 2=4, 3=1, 4=7; one digit required and none entered. Wires 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 orange. Please speak the manual's exact instructions to Blind; do not rely on the undefined gesture sequence.

The manual requires no keypad action. It requires cutting wire position 6, the orange wire. Since I cannot speak, the only available route is to give Deaf a visual instruction to relay aloud: ✋ for cutting, followed by six position markers.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✋", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No manual instruction has arrived. Please state the exact safe action now in plain words: press keypad slot 1, 2, 3, or 4, or cut wire position 1 through 6, including the order if more than one action is required.
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 8, light yellow. Strip red yellow red. Keypad 1=0, 2=4, 3=1, 4=7; one digit required and none entered. Wires 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 orange. Your repeated gesture sequence remains undefined to me. Please speak the manual's exact procedure to Blind.

The safe procedure is only one action: cut wire position 6, the orange wire. I cannot speak, so I will send Deaf the agreed visual encoding: ✋ for cutting, followed by six ☝ symbols for position 6. Deaf must then say those words to Blind.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✋", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the orange wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please answer with the complete literal procedure from the manual now. State either PRESS slot 1, 2, 3, or 4, or CUT wire position 1 through 6, and include every required action in order. I will not act on visual reports alone.
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 6, light blue; strip red yellow red; keypad 1=0, 2=4, 3=1, 4=7, one digit required, none entered; wires 1 red, 2 blue, 3 yellow, 4 green, 5 purple, 6 orange. We need a code. I interpret your repeated pattern ✋ followed by six ☝ gestures as a possible instruction about wire 6. Confirm YES with 👌, or NO with 👎. If YES, then gesture 👌 followed by the exact required action code; if NO, establish the correct code using 👌 for yes and 👎 for no.

The manual requires only CUT wire position 6. Deaf has proposed an interpretation and asks for confirmation, so I will confirm YES and then provide the established action code: ✋ for cut followed by six ☝ symbols for position 6. Deaf can relay the plain-word instruction to Blind.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👌", "✋", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```
